title: राप्रपा कमजोर अवस्थामा छ, यसैगरी चले स्थानीय चुनावमा उम्मेदवार नपाउनसक्छ : कमल थापा (भिडिओ)
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । राप्रपाका नेता कमल थापाले पार्टी आफ्नो ३५ वर्ष लामो इतिहासमा अहिले सबैभन्दा बढी कमजोर अवस्थामा पुगेको दाबी गरेका छन्। वीरगंजमा आयोजित अन्तरक्रिया कार्यक्रममा बोल्दै अबको विकल्पको रूपमा स्थापित हुनुपर्ने बेलामा पार्टी कमजोर भएको बताए। उनले भने, ‘एकातर्फ राजाको लोकप्रियता बढेको छ, जनताले राजा खोजिराखेका छन्। त्यसैगरी जनताले हिन्दू राष्ट्र खोजिराखेका छन्। जनताले भ्रष्टाचारको अन्त्य गरेर सुशासन खोजेका छन्, आर्थिक समृद्धि खोजेका छन्, बेरोजगारीको अन्त्य खोजेका छन्। र यो विचार बोक्ने एउटै मात्र दल राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी भने इतिहासमै सबैभन्दा कमजोर भएको छ।’ चुनावमा हार वा जितको कारणले मात्र नभई संगठनात्मक दृष्टिकोणबाटै अहिले पार्टी कमजोर भएको बताए। उनले पार्टीप्रति नेता कार्यकर्ताको उत्साह नै नभएको बताए। उनले थपे, ‘विभिन्न तहका कार्यसमितिमा बस्न चाहनेहरू पनि निराश रहेका छन्, उत्सुकतै छैन। काठमाडौं जस्तो देशको राजधानीको जिल्ला, जुन काठमाडौँ जिल्लाबाट २०७० सालको चुनावमा हामीले कांग्रेस, एमाले र माओवादीभन्दा बढी मत पाएका थियौँ, त्यो जिल्लाको कार्यसमितिको चुनावमा निर्विरोध हुन पाउने हुँदा पनि त्यहाँ पर्याप्त सङ्ख्यामा सदस्य भएनन्।’ उनले आगामी दिनमा पार्टी नेतृत्वले प्रवृत्तिमा सुधार गर्दै जानुपर्ने बताए। ‘पार्टी यति कमजोर अवस्थामा यसभन्दा अगाडि कहिल्यै थिएन। अब ३ महिना पछाडि स्थानीय चुनाव हुँदै छ। फागुन देखि त स्थानीय चुनाव सुरु हुन्छ। उम्मेदवार पाउन नसक्ने अवस्थामा हामी पुगेका छौँ’ पूर्वअध्यक्ष समेत रहेका थापाले भने। यद्यपि उनले नेता कार्यकर्तालाई निराश नभई पार्टीका अभियानमा लाग्न आग्रह गरे। आफूहरूले नसकेपनि नयाँ पुस्ताले हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्था पुनर्स्थापना गरेरै छाड्ने विश्वास व्यक्त गरे। उनले थपे, ‘हामीले फेरि राप्रपालाई पुनर्जागृत गर्नैपर्छ, उठाउनु पर्दछ र उठाउन सकिन्छ। त्यसको निमित्त तपाईँहरू पार्टीका कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूमा उच्च मनोबल हुनुपर्छ। कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूको उच्च मनोबल रहन सक्यो भने राप्रपा चाँडै नै जाग्नेछ। ६ महिना अगाडि खडा भएको राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीले एउटै चुनावबाट झन्डै दुई–तिहाइ ल्याउन सक्छ भने हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डा बोकेको राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टीले जनताको माझमा गएर देशको अवस्था र पार्टीको एजेन्डाका बारेमा ठीक ढङ्गबाट बुझाउन सक्यो भने एउटै चुनावबाट अत्यधिक बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्दछ।’ महाधिवेशनबाट हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डालाई स्थापित गर्न सक्ने दृढ इच्छाशक्ति भएको नेतृत्व चयन गर्न सक्नुपर्ने बताए। ‘म नै सर्वेसर्वा हुँ, म नै पार्टी हुँ, मेरो कसैले विरोध गर्छ भने उसलाई पार्टीमा स्थान छैन’ भन्ने प्रवृत्ति कायम रहँदासम्म पार्टी अगाडि बढ्न नसक्ने टिप्पणी गरे। Kathmandu. RPP leader Kamal Thapa has claimed that the party is now in the weakest position in its 35-year history. Speaking at an interaction program organized in Birgunj, he said that the party has become weak at a time when it should be established as an alternative. He said, 'On the one hand, the popularity of the king has increased, the people are looking for a king. Similarly, the people are looking for a Hindu nation. The people have sought good governance by ending corruption, seeking economic prosperity, and an end to unemployment. And the only party that carries this idea, the Rastriya Prajatantra Party, has become the weakest in history.' He said that the party is weak not only because of the election defeat or victory but also from an organizational perspective. He said that the leaders and workers lack enthusiasm for the party. He added, "Those who want to sit on the working committees at various levels are also disappointed, not eager. In the capital district of the country like Kathmandu, from which we received more votes than the Congress, UML and Maoists in the 2070 BS elections, even though we were allowed to run unopposed in the district working committee elections, we did not have a sufficient number of members." He said that the party leadership should continue to improve its attitude in the coming days. "The party has never been in such a weak state before. Now, local elections are being held three months later. Local elections start from Falgun. We have reached a point where we cannot find candidates," said Thapa, who is also a former president. However, he urged the leaders and workers not to get discouraged and continue with the party's campaign. He expressed confidence that even if they were unable to do so, the new generation would restore the Hindu nation and the monarchy. He added, 'We must revive the RPP again, we must raise it and we can raise it. For that, you party cadres and friends should have high morale. If the cadres and friends can maintain high morale, the RPP will wake up soon. The National Independent Party, which was formed six months ago, can bring almost two-thirds of the votes in a single election, while the Rastriya Prajatantra Party, which carries the agenda of a Hindu nation and monarchy, can get a huge majority in a single election if it can go among the people and explain the situation of the country and the party's agenda properly.' He said that the general convention should be able to elect a strong-willed leadership capable of establishing the agenda of a Hindu nation and monarchy. He commented that the party will not be able to move forward as long as the attitude persists that "I am the supreme authority, I am the party, if anyone opposes me, they have no place in the party."

पुनर्जागृत गर्नैपर्छ, उठाउनु पर्दछ र उठाउन सकिन्छ। त्यसको निमित्त तपाईँहरू पार्टीका कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूमा उच्च मनोबल हुनुपर्छ। कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूको उच्च मनोबल रहन सक्यो भने राप्रपा चाँडै नै जाग्नेछ। ६ महिना अगाडि खडा भएको राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीले एउटै चुनावबाट झन्डै दुई–तिहाइ ल्याउन सक्छ भने हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डा बोकेको राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टीले जनताको माझमा गएर देशको अवस्था र पार्टीको एजेन्डाका बारेमा ठीक ढङ्गबाट बुझाउन सक्यो भने एउटै चुनावबाट अत्यधिक बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्दछ।’ महाधिवेशनबाट हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डालाई स्थापित गर्न सक्ने दृढ इच्छाशक्ति भएको नेतृत्व चयन गर्न सक्नुपर्ने बताए। ‘म नै सर्वेसर्वा हुँ, म नै पार्टी हुँ, मेरो कसैले विरोध गर्छ भने उसलाई पार्टीमा स्थान छैन’ भन्ने प्रवृत्ति कायम रहँदासम्म पार्टी अगाडि बढ्न नसक्ने टिप्पणी गरे। Kathmandu. RPP leader Kamal Thapa has claimed that the party is now in the weakest position in its 35-year history. Speaking at an interaction program organized in Birgunj, he said that the party has become weak at a time when it should be established as an alternative. He said, 'On the one hand, the popularity of the king has increased, the people are looking for a king. Similarly, the people are looking for a Hindu nation. The people have sought good governance by ending corruption, seeking economic prosperity, and an end to unemployment. And the only party that carries this idea, the Rastriya Prajatantra Party, has become the weakest in history.' He said that the party is weak not only because of the election defeat or victory but also from an organizational perspective. He said that the leaders and workers lack enthusiasm for the party. He added, "Those who want to sit on the working committees at various levels are also disappointed, not eager. In the capital district of the country like Kathmandu, from which we received more votes than the Congress, UML and Maoists in the 2070 BS elections, even though we were allowed to run unopposed in the district working committee elections, we did not have a sufficient number of members." He said that the party leadership should continue to improve its attitude in the coming days. "The party has never been in such a weak state before. Now, local elections are being held three months later. Local elections start from Falgun. We have reached a point where we cannot find candidates," said Thapa, who is also a former president. However, he urged the leaders and workers not to get discouraged and continue with the party's campaign. He expressed confidence that even if they were unable to do so, the new generation would restore the Hindu nation and the monarchy. He added, 'We must revive the RPP again, we must raise it and we can raise it. For that, you party cadres and friends should have high morale. If the cadres and friends can maintain high morale, the RPP will wake up soon. The National Independent Party, which was formed six months ago, can bring almost two-thirds of the votes in a single election, while the Rastriya Prajatantra Party, which carries the agenda of a Hindu nation and monarchy, can get a huge majority in a single election if it can go among the people and explain the situation of the country and the party's agenda properly.' He said that the general convention should be able to elect a strong-willed leadership capable of establishing the agenda of a Hindu nation and monarchy. He commented that the party will not be able to move forward as long as the attitude persists that "I am the supreme authority, I am the party, if anyone opposes me, they have no place in the party."

काठमाडौं । राप्रपाका नेता कमल थापाले पार्टी आफ्नो ३५ वर्ष लामो इतिहासमा अहिले सबैभन्दा बढी कमजोर अवस्थामा पुगेको दाबी गरेका छन्। वीरगंजमा आयोजित अन्तरक्रिया कार्यक्रममा बोल्दै अबको विकल्पको रूपमा स्थापित हुनुपर्ने बेलामा पार्टी कमजोर भएको बताए। उनले भने, ‘एकातर्फ राजाको लोकप्रियता बढेको छ, जनताले राजा खोजिराखेका छन्। त्यसैगरी जनताले हिन्दू राष्ट्र खोजिराखेका छन्। जनताले भ्रष्टाचारको अन्त्य गरेर सुशासन खोजेका छन्, आर्थिक समृद्धि खोजेका छन्, बेरोजगारीको अन्त्य खोजेका छन्। र यो विचार बोक्ने एउटै मात्र दल राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी भने इतिहासमै सबैभन्दा कमजोर भएको छ।’ चुनावमा हार वा जितको कारणले मात्र नभई संगठनात्मक दृष्टिकोणबाटै अहिले पार्टी कमजोर भएको बताए। उनले पार्टीप्रति नेता कार्यकर्ताको उत्साह नै नभएको बताए। उनले थपे, ‘विभिन्न तहका कार्यसमितिमा बस्न चाहनेहरू पनि निराश रहेका छन्, उत्सुकतै छैन। काठमाडौं जस्तो देशको राजधानीको जिल्ला, जुन काठमाडौँ जिल्लाबाट २०७० सालको चुनावमा हामीले कांग्रेस, एमाले र माओवादीभन्दा बढी मत पाएका थियौँ, त्यो जिल्लाको कार्यसमितिको चुनावमा निर्विरोध हुन पाउने हुँदा पनि त्यहाँ पर्याप्त सङ्ख्यामा सदस्य भएनन्।’ उनले आगामी दिनमा पार्टी नेतृत्वले प्रवृत्तिमा सुधार गर्दै जानुपर्ने बताए। ‘पार्टी यति कमजोर अवस्थामा यसभन्दा अगाडि कहिल्यै थिएन। अब ३ महिना पछाडि स्थानीय चुनाव हुँदै छ। फागुन देखि त स्थानीय चुनाव सुरु हुन्छ। उम्मेदवार पाउन नसक्ने अवस्थामा हामी पुगेका छौँ’ पूर्वअध्यक्ष समेत रहेका थापाले भने। यद्यपि उनले नेता कार्यकर्तालाई निराश नभई पार्टीका अभियानमा लाग्न आग्रह गरे। आफूहरूले नसकेपनि नयाँ पुस्ताले हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्था पुनर्स्थापना गरेरै छाड्ने विश्वास व्यक्त गरे। उनले थपे, ‘हामीले फेरि राप्रपालाई पुनर्जागृत गर्नैपर्छ, उठाउनु पर्दछ र उठाउन सकिन्छ। त्यसको निमित्त तपाईँहरू पार्टीका कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूमा उच्च मनोबल हुनुपर्छ। कार्यकर्ता साथीहरूको उच्च मनोबल रहन सक्यो भने राप्रपा चाँडै नै जाग्नेछ। ६ महिना अगाडि खडा भएको राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीले एउटै चुनावबाट झन्डै दुई–तिहाइ ल्याउन सक्छ भने हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डा बोकेको राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टीले जनताको माझमा गएर देशको अवस्था र पार्टीको एजेन्डाका बारेमा ठीक ढङ्गबाट बुझाउन सक्यो भने एउटै चुनावबाट अत्यधिक बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्दछ।’ महाधिवेशनबाट हिन्दू राष्ट्र र राजसंस्थाको एजेन्डालाई स्थापित गर्न सक्ने दृढ इच्छाशक्ति भएको नेतृत्व चयन गर्न सक्नुपर्ने बताए। ‘म नै सर्वेसर्वा हुँ, म नै पार्टी हुँ, मेरो कसैले विरोध गर्छ भने उसलाई पार्टीमा स्थान छैन’ भन्ने प्रवृत्ति कायम रहँदासम्म पार्टी अगाडि बढ्न नसक्ने टिप्पणी गरे।

Kathmandu. RPP leader Kamal Thapa has claimed that the party is now in the weakest position in its 35-year history. Speaking at an interaction program organized in Birgunj, he said that the party has become weak at a time when it should be established as an alternative. He said, 'On the one hand, the popularity of the king has increased, the people are looking for a king. Similarly, the people are looking for a Hindu nation. The people have sought good governance by ending corruption, seeking economic prosperity, and an end to unemployment. And the only party that carries this idea, the Rastriya Prajatantra Party, has become the weakest in history.' He said that the party is weak not only because of the election defeat or victory but also from an organizational perspective. He said that the leaders and workers lack enthusiasm for the party. He added, "Those who want to sit on the working committees at various levels are also disappointed, not eager. In the capital district of the country like Kathmandu, from which we received more votes than the Congress, UML and Maoists in the 2070 BS elections, even though we were allowed to run unopposed in the district working committee elections, we did not have a sufficient number of members." He said that the party leadership should continue to improve its attitude in the coming days. "The party has never been in such a weak state before.
